rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE PHILIPPINE RUBBER AUTHORITY, DEFINING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Rationale: It is imperative now that the government should give the appropriate support to the industry considering the potential growth of the rubber industry as more and more uses of the product are discovered. The outlook for producers of naturalrubber is bright in the short and long-term basis. If given the proper support, the projected increase in trend and stable position of natural rubber in the world market may provide an excellent potential for local producers to tap.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 2001-12-19

rows.author: B004
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A REPRODUCTIVE HEALTH CARE ACT, STRENGTHENING ITS IMPLEMENTING STRUCTURES, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "The Reproductive Health Care Agenda of 2001". This bill seeks to establish an Integrated National Policy and Program on Reproductive Health that recognizes women's reproductive rights, gender equality and ensures universal access to reproductive health, services, information and education. This bill, recognizes the basic right of all individuals and couples to decide freely and responsibly the number, spacing and timing of their children and the right to make decisions concerning reproductionfree of discrimination, coercion and violence.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2001-12-19

rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE CHARTER OF THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT ACADEMY (LGA), AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 262, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS `THE REORGANIZATION ACT OF THE DEPARTMENT OF LOCAL GOVERNMENT AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES' AND REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6975,OTHERWISE KNOWN AS `THE DEPARTMENT OF INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT ACT OF 1990', PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Among the functions of the proposed LOCAL GOVERNMENT ACADEMY are: (1) Design and implement training and human resource development programs for local government units, executives and functionaries and the DILG personnel that will ultimately effect institutional development and organizational effectiveness; (2) Assist the DILG in promulgating policies, rules and regulations and other issues relative to human resource development and training for LGUs; (3) Establish and maintain a mechanism to enable LGUs to access technical as well as financial assistance in building institutional capabilities to respond to the needs of local governance within the framework of local autonomy; and (4) Develop a corps of efficient, effective and competent LGAA staff provided with all the remuneration and benefits needed for their enhancement and satisfaction.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2002-01-14

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A FARM MACHINERIES MANUFACTURING PROGRAM AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: This bill seeks to provide for the establishment of a Farm Machineries Manufacturing Program.  A comprehensive program that shall introduce mechanized farming to boast production is very important. It is through the Farm Machineries Manufacturing Program that this idea could be achieved. Local manufacturers shall be encourages to enter into a joint venture with foreign companies that shall assist and train then with the view of enabling them to maximize the utilization of local materials in their products.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE, FOOD & FISHERIES since 2002-01-15

rows.title_full: AN ACT EXEMPTING THE INCOME AND RECEIPTS FROM LOANS USED TO FINANCE AGRICULTURALLY BASED AND/OR LOCATED ACTIVITIES AND BUSINESSES FROM TAXES
rows.abstract: All income and receipts from loans used to finance agriculturally based, related and/or located activities and businesses shall be exempted from all taxes, including gross receipts and income tax.  Given this opportunity, our farmers will be able touse the savings from the exemption to uplift their production. This will also raise their social and economic standard.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2002-01-15

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE SOLAR ENERGY DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: This bill seeks to establish the solar energy development authority. Being a tropical country, the Philippines is blessed with abundant sunlight which can be tapped as an inexhaustible, cheap and environmentally safe source of energy. As compared toother conventional fuel, solar energy merely harnesses the heat of the sun hence, it does not pollute the aur nor the sea.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT ENTERPRISES AND PRIVATIZATION since 2002-01-15

rows.abstract: This bill seeks to appropriate the amount of TWO MILLION PESOS (P2,000,000.00) for the construction of cooperative center in every congressional district of the country.> By way of assistance, the construction of a cooperative center will give thena place to conduct their cooperatives business. In the cooperative center, the cooperatives will have a place taht will serve they can keep their products. This center will entice small businessmen to form cooperative.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on COOPERATIVES DEVELOPMENT since 2002-01-15

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A NEW QUEDAN SYSTEM IN THE MARKETING OF PALAY AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract: The National Food Authority shall determine the floor price for the palay which shall assure the farmers or producers a fair return on their investment and procure and buy from the farmers their palay crops payment for which shall be seventy-five percent in cash and a quedan shall be issued for the remaining balance which shall be paid within sixty days from the time the palay is delivered to its warehouses or within such time as may be agreed upon by the NFA and the farmers/produce rs.

rows.title_full: AN ACT DECLARING ALL IRRIGATED AND IRRIGABLE AGRICULTURAL LANDS AS PROTECTED AREAS FOR AGRICULTURE, BANNING ITS CONVERSION FOR USES OTHER THAN AGRICULTURE, AND AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 20 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE
rows.abstract: "National Protected Areas for Agriculture (NPAA) Law". Rationale: The pre-requisite to the attainment of food security is the availability of irrigated and irrigable agricultural lands. But this is threatened by land conversions. From 1989 to 1993 alone, a total of 109,000 hectares of irrigated land have been converted into industrial, commercual and residential uses. If the trend is not arrested, the country will soon face the prospect of irretrivably losing agricultural land, a primary, non-renewable and non-replenishab le resource.> Agricultural lands, must thus be secured not only to provide food and long-term food security to an ever-growing population, but also to provide green and breathing spaces for rapidly expanding urban centerss.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on AGRICULTURE, FOOD & FISHERIES since 2002-01-22
